children: Uniphos Enterprises appoints the real estate veteran as it diversifies into property development, with plans to unlock value from its existing land parcels

Girish Goenka has been appointed Chief Executive Officer of Uniphos Enterprises Limited (UEL), moving from his previous role as Chief Financial Officer at Piramal Realty. His appointment is effective 6 November 2026, according to a regulatory disclosure by the company.

UEL is the real estate and development arm of United Phosphorus Limited (UPL). His appointment comes alongside the company’s proposed diversification into real estate, leveraging its existing land parcels and exploring opportunities across the property development value chain.

Goenka said he has joined the group as CEO – Real Estate, and described his mandate in clear terms: “To bring out the best value of the land parcels and real estate already existing in the entity and the group, and look for other opportunities that would come for development over a period of time.”

The company said Goenka brings over 25 years of leadership experience across real estate, infrastructure, manufacturing and export sectors. Before Piramal Realty, he held senior finance and strategic leadership positions at R Retail Ventures, a Warburg Pincus-Runwal joint venture, Godrej Properties, Mahindra Lifespace Developers and Gammon Group entities.
A qualified Certified Public Accountant (USA) and Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Goenka also holds an MBA in Finance, along with M.Com and B.Com degrees from the University of Mumbai.
